title: PatchTST: Patch tokenisation reduces long-horizon error accumulation for PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTm1, Electricity
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using PatchTST, a patch-based channel-independent transformer. On ETTh1, ETTm1, Electricity, at horizon 720, Patch tokenisation reduces long-horizon error accumulation for PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTm1, Electricity. PatchTST shows a 27% smaller MSE increase from horizon 336 to 720 than autoregressive transformer baselines. We discuss two limitations: Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified. Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity.
